dev_bootstrap.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(0), restarted for every detector and run
dev_bootstrap.resample: class-stratified, with replacement, tau_EER re-estimated by metrics.eer

kde.bandwidth: Silverman (0.9 min(sd, IQR / 1.34) n^-0.2) per class
kde.threshold: FRR = FAR of the smoothed curves (Brent, xtol 1e-10)

meta.isotonic: PAV on dev, threshold midway between the dev scores where the posterior crosses the dev prior
meta.logistic: unpenalised (C = 1e12) on dev, equal-prior Bayes threshold (E9)
